method: Tracked-file search of localflow/, scripts/ and tests/ (git grep / rg) for the handoff's service, predicate, table and knob keys, plus every direct SQL writer of an M14 table; each hit read in context. Aliases resolved: the coordinator holds the services as AppDelegate._learning/_review/_sampling/_splits/_profile/_exporter and hands them to the Hub spec as learning_service/review_service/sampling_service/splits_service/profile_service/export_service; HubState receives the same objects. The exporter class is DatasetExporter (no ExportService exists). No dynamic dispatch (getattr by name, registries) reaches these services; background completion runs through HubController._in_background → AppHelper.callAfter → _finish_action. No caller exists outside localflow/, scripts/ and tests/ (a tracked-file search of the rest of the tree finds only documentation).
